info.title: Rehablo clinical workspace API
info.description: Additive feature, default disabled. All staff endpoints enforce active tenant and selected structure, role, explicit care-path membership and visibility. Responses use the existing status/message/data envelope. Daily results require own DRAFT evaluation created today. Confirmed programs/reports/prescriptions are immutable; create revisions. See clinical-rollout.md for rollout and deferred integrations.

post.description: Legacy endpoint retains existing ordinary flow. With a care path it also enforces current path membership and clinical visibility. Test definitions and ownership come from the server. No outcome is inferred from an omitted isPositive.

operationId.description: Optional UUID for stable retry; same command returns the existing instance without duplicating the body point.

get.summary: Existing evaluation detail with daily capability flags, areas and historical test definitions
get.description: This documents the additive response fields only; existing evaluation, point, scale, questionnaire and Observation collections remain in the response.

403.description: Current scope or membership does not permit access

409.description: Evaluation is completed or its creation day has expired; result is immutable

Record.description: Server-owned identity, author, version, publication metadata and capability flags. data is selected by kind; SESSION includes immutable programSnapshot, DOCUMENT includes fileName/mimeType/sizeBytes/checksumSha256.

LegacyPointToCreate.description: Existing SVG body-map coordinates. The point and test instance are saved atomically; user/tenant ownership is server-controlled.

ClinicalTestSnapshot.description: Textual public-catalog definition captured by the server at creation. Clients cannot select or overwrite the historical snapshot.

isPositive.description: null means not recorded; false is an explicit negative outcome.

test.description: Historical snapshot projection when available; catalog fallback only for legacy instances without a snapshot.

humanBodyPoint.description: Returned on creation when linked to a point.

symptom.description: Area symptom snapshot, retained with its own area and evaluation; no artificial body point or quantitative Observation is generated.
